notes.title: Hell of Men: Blood Brothers - New factions!
notes.content:
Hello to all,  

Today, you will discover in this article, the new faction that will be available in v1.  The Baltic Countries are coming in Hell of Men: Blood Brothers! 
The Baltic Countries are represented by 3 skins in the game. Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4630a5d1170237b4502e4a83035730ca4609eb16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/340d992c4a52b3284b2fc0e2579599b5b803f9b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4e38f8ae854f95e9249f124932b3197cbc044c5a.png[/img]

[u][b]Building:[/b][/u]
The buildings have a "container" style, we find the same as for the other factions except for the infirmary which disappears.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/62bd125ede5892b77a665a2c1cd8d04b0cc42591.png[/img]

The specificity of the tent is its low cost which can give an advantage at the beginning of the game, however it offers only 3 additional population slots. You will have to build more tents than the other factions to reach the maximum of 40 units.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8a7b2ed6926d01a888698d3305a1481fa6a90e0d.png[/img]

[u][b]Unit:[/b][/u]
[u]Barracks:[/u] 
[list]
[*] Rifleman = Germany/Russia.  
[*] Grenade launcher = all factions.  
[*] Rocket launcher = Poland/Russia.  
[*] Fusion launcher = all factions.  
[*] Operator = Poland/Belarus.  
[*] Machine gunner/Mastodon = + 1 damage / 0.1 rate of fire reduction.  
[*] Sniper/Sniper guillie = - 5 damage / increase rate of fire by +2.  
[/list]

[u]Communication Center:[/u]
[list]
[*] Sapper = Russia - short range.  
[*] Tank crew = Poland/Russia/Belarus.  
[*] Mortar = - 1 damage / increase movement speed by +0.3. 
[/list]

[u]Laboratory:[/u]
[list]
[*] UAV = all factions.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-infantry combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-tank combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Healing Drone.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/af5cd58a9dc3bf64e5e048ab23f866e6fee12f21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/019fc0b235d69e476159dc278b8e04fa41cf1b02.png[/img]

The anti-infantry combat drone is inspired by the Estonian Milsem drone with its anti-vehicle variant. It has the same attack stats as the Russian drone with a higher hit point count and reduced speed. Its anti-tank variant joins the French anti-tank drone but uses rockets.  

The healing drone is a flying drone with the ability to heal infantry units.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/16eb4b90e466eb160bdd1b08bcbd9c863b5094f0.png[/img]
 

[u]Vehicle:[/u]  
The Buggy is equal to the other factions with only 3 seats.  
The Jeep is equipped with a grenade launcher and reduced armor –20 health points.  
The Truck is equal to the German faction and unarmed.  
The Armored Support is equal to that of the Polish faction.  
The Light Tank is equal to that of the Polish faction with reinforced armor giving it +50 health points.  
The Tank is equal to the other factions with a reinforced armor giving it +50 health points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/25cc80b355912943fde0a799a5cd71872f49d713.png[/img]
